test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

My friend said to me, “Do you want to accompany us on this tour?”

options.text: My friend asked me if I wanted to accompany us on that tour.
My friend asked me if he wanted to accompany them on that tour.
My friend asked me if I wanted to accompany them on that tour?
My friend asked me if I wanted to accompany them on that tour.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** My friend asked me if I wanted to accompany them on that tour.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Do you want" becomes "if I wanted"**
 
 
• Question "Do you want" is converted to an indirect question "if I wan
